Where the two estimators disagree most is also where averaging cuts variance most if the match is the same cell. Private EV is ~0 +/- 0.0005, and a 0.958 read would be a knob picked on one public embryo (winner's curse), not a finals improvement. (4) Slot cost and schedule. Also, the name exp89a is already taken (exp79a + DISAPPEARANCE 2.25 in scan_hyp_sched29). P(display >= 0.958) is ~0.1-0.15, not 0.2-0.3.
